{"query":"SELECT
  url,
  title,
  UNNEST(
    SEM_EXTRACT_ALL(
      content,
      'a mechanical keyboard model with a stated first public availability, launch, release, or shipping date between 2016-09-01 and 2026-08-31',
      model := 'brand and model name',
      release_date := 'first public availability, launch, release, or shipping date, YYYY-MM-DD when stated; otherwise YYYY-MM',
      date_type := 'whether the date is first availability, launch, announcement, preorder, or shipping',
      category := 'keyboard category such as gaming, enthusiast custom, productivity, ergonomic, low-profile, or other',
      evidence := 'per_field'
    ),
    recursive := true
  )
FROM WEB_SEARCH(
  'mechanical keyboard release dates timeline 2016 2017 2018 2019',
  'mechanical keyboard releases 2020 2021 2022 launch dates',
  'mechanical keyboard releases 2023 2024 2025 launch dates',
  'site:razer.com newsroom mechanical keyboard launched',
  'site:corsair.com news mechanical keyboard launched',
  'site:logitech.com press mechanical keyboard launch',
  'site:keychron.com blogs/news mechanical keyboard release',
  'site:wooting.io post keyboard release shipping',
  'site:steelseries.com press mechanical keyboard launch',
  'site:asus.com news ROG mechanical keyboard launch',
  'site:drop.com mechanical keyboard launched release',
  'site:pcgamer.com mechanical keyboard launched release date'
)
WHERE SEM_MATCH(
  content,
  'states a release, launch, first availability, or first shipping date for a specific mechanical keyboard model between September 2016 and August 2026'
)","show_preview":false}
